maze_geometry.source_contract: bits 0-3 are N/E/S/W; enemy_direction_legal rejects a direction absent from the current cell mask

approval_proposal.change: Replace the paired same-direction 36-callback alignment gate with a candidate-side 24-callback displacement sample. Keep the paired baseline build and exact identity receipts for source/reference use, but do not require its actor to occupy the same route or remain in the same direction during the candidate sample.
approval_proposal.preserves: Approved arcade rate schedule, movement formula, one-pixel endpoint tolerance, Part-7 target addend, production scope, dependency order, and separate freeze/death/reversal checks.

measurement.reference_type: formula projection, not a live measurement

approval_proposal.success_marker: A single exact candidate ROM remains on one legal horizontal direction for 24 real enemy callbacks, with active slot/type continuity, nonzero movement, at least one no-movement callback, complete rate/map identity, FRONT actor pixels, FB_SIM_SEQ, and FRAMES captured; candidate displacement is 28 pixels within one endpoint pixel.
approval_proposal.timeout_meaning: No qualifying candidate straight segment or required marker completed within 45 seconds; no cadence conclusion.
approval_proposal.writes: None during displacement sample; no actor, RNG, maze, gate, framebuffer, owner, or mapping changes.
approval_proposal.dependencies_order: BUG-086 actualDone; reuse current candidate current-root build; after protocol approval update only verifier/plan/evidence targets, regenerate the resolved plan, then rerun candidate natural-init and Part-7 progression under fresh authorization before the single displacement phase.
approval_proposal.risks: This removes baseline actor-route comparability from the movement sample; the candidate remains judged directly against the arcade-derived formula. The sample can still fail if the candidate turns or dies before 24 callbacks. No other part threshold is proved by this single Part-7 sample.
scope_exclusions: No enemy AI or RNG changes
No relaxed rate target or displacement tolerance
No change to freeze/death bypass or legal reversal acceptance
approval_proposal.cost_class: High-risk; existing class and profile memory limits unchanged.

decision_required: Coding-architect guardrail requires explicit user approval before implementing this modified runtime-observation protocol.
